_comment: Secrets bound by deploy/backend.cloudbuild.yaml that a deploy lane deliberately does
not pass. Every substitution defaults to "" and add_secret skips empties, so an
omission produces a service missing that environment variable with no error anywhere.
scripts/ci/check-deploy-secret-coverage.py fails on any omission not listed here.
Adding an entry requires a reason. 'Pre-existing' means it was inherited, not approved.

reasons._HUSHH_MANAGED_GEMINI_LIVE_API_KEY_SECRE: Bound by cloudbuild but passed by NO lane. Either dead configuration or broken everywhere; nobody has needed it. Investigate before adding.
reasons._OMNIGATEWAY_CLIENT_ID_SECRET: Pre-existing omission, recorded when this check was added on 2026-09-08. Not yet justified.
reasons._OMNIGATEWAY_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRET: Pre-existing omission, recorded when this check was added on 2026-09-08. Not yet justified.
reasons._OMNIGATEWAY_EXT_CRM_CLIENT_ID_SECRET: Pre-existing omission, recorded when this check was added on 2026-09-08. Not yet justified.
reasons._OMNIGATEWAY_EXT_CRM_CLIENT_SECRET_SECRE: Pre-existing omission, recorded when this check was added on 2026-09-08. Not yet justified.
reasons._HUSHH_UAT_PHONE_TEST_CHALLENGE_SECRET_S: NOT deliberate. The UAT phone-test challenge key falls back to APP_SIGNING_KEY (api/routes/account.py _phone_test_challenge_key), so test codes work today but silently change the day that key rotates. Bind it only after confirming the secret exists: gcloud secrets describe HUSHH_UAT_PHONE_TEST_CHALLENGE_SECRET --project=hushh-pda-uat. Binding a secret that does not exist makes the revision never become ready (R1).
reasons._HUSHH_PROD_PHONE_TEST_NUMBERS_SECRET: Production-only fixed-OTP test config; must not exist outside production.
